comments.note: The file:../cli-menu reference is a monorepo-local path. Any checkout of ai-insights without the sibling cli-menu directory will fail npm install. This is expected and intentional for workspace development; worth noting in onboarding docs.

summary: Reviewed the single-line change adding '@mistralys/cli-menu': 'file:../cli-menu' to ai-insights/package.json. Change is correct, minimal, and well-scoped. The file: protocol is the canonical npm approach for local workspace packages; the relative path '../cli-menu' correctly resolves to the sibling DEV/cli-menu directory. package-lock.json update is the expected side-effect of npm install.

No behavioral issues, architectural concerns, or logic bugs identified. All three ACs are met, QA confirmed 229/229 regression tests passing. Two low-priority observations recorded — no blocking issues.

comments.note: The package was placed in 'dependencies' rather than 'devDependencies'. For this 'private: true' workspace root this has zero functional impact (npm install installs both sections by default and cd to production deployment is not a scenario). However, vitest is in devDependencies and @mistralys/cli-menu serves the same dev-only scripting purpose — there is a mild semantic inconsistency. A future cleanup could move it to devDependencies for consistency.

[documentation-forward] The 'file:../cli-menu' reference is a local-path monorepo link that requires ai-insights/ and cli-menu/ to be sibling directories. The ai-insights onboarding documentation (README.md or workspace setup guide) should explicitly note this prerequisite so contributors who clone only ai-insights understand why npm install may fail and what directory structure is required.
